answer: The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in zephyr, expire in echo, and grove lists each expiry. An adversary running 140 aliases as a result needs 181 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4996 identities would post 2537 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
